root_cause.text: TOCTOU race between counting space info entries and filling the buffer, due to releasing groups_sem between passes, allowing concurrent block group removal to reduce the entry count, causing copy_to_user to copy uninitialized heap data.
root_cause.evidence: Patch description states: "TOCTOU race between two passes over the block group RAID type lists... groups_sem rwlock is released between passes, allowing concurrent block group removal to reduce the entry count. When the second pass fills fewer entries than the first pass counted, copy_to_user() copies the full alloc_size bytes including trailing uninitialized kmalloc bytes to userspace." Also the fix changes copy_to_user to use total_spaces count and switches to kzalloc.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace kmalloc with kzalloc to zero-initialize memory, preventing potential information leaks from uninitialized kernel memory in btrfs ioctl space info.
intent_record.what: Changed memory allocation from kmalloc to kzalloc for the dest buffer in btrfs_ioctl_space_info.
intent_record.how: The buffer is now zero-initialized at allocation time, preventing exposure of uninitialized kernel heap memory and ensuring fields default to zero.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix copy_to_user size to copy only the actual number of space_info entries instead of the allocated buffer size.
intent_record.what: Changed the third argument of copy_to_user from alloc_size to space_args.total_spaces * sizeof(*dest_orig).
intent_record.how: The kernel now copies only the number of bytes equal to the actual count of space info entries (total_spaces) times the struct size, instead of the full allocated buffer size, preventing potential information leak or over-copy.

grouping_result.intent: Fix copy_to_user size to copy only the actual number of space_info entries instead of the allocated buffer size.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix potential information leaks in btrfs ioctl space info by zero-initializing allocated memory and copying only the actual number of entries to userspace.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the TOCTOU race vulnerability by zero-initializing the heap buffer to prevent leaking uninitialized data and by copying only the actual number of entries, which mitigates the race condition where concurrent block group removal reduces the entry count.

candidates.rationale: Allocates uninitialized heap memory, which may later be copied to userspace if the number of filled entries is less than the allocated size due to a TOCTOU race.

Copies the entire allocated buffer to userspace, including uninitialized portions, because the actual number of entries may be less than alloc_size due to concurrent block group removal reducing the entry count between counting and filling.
